name: frame-light-leak-cinema
tagline_zh: 给视频加一道漏光，像老放映机刚开机。16:9黑边压住画面，衬线大字浮上来，三秒做出章节卡，不装插件不调色。
tagline_en: Add a light leak and grain, letterbox to 16:9, overlay serif type—cinematic chapter cards in seconds, no plugins.
desc_en: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字, 电影感开场 / 章节卡
why_zh: 同类靠滤镜堆效果，它直接改HTML结构，漏光颗粒随帧动，像真胶片在呼吸，不是贴图。
why_en: Others fake it with filters; this manipulates HTML per frame, so grain and leaks move organically—like real film, not a sticker.
